data.notes_barbara:
Different industry; Different products; Different customer needs; Different business model

Church & Dwight sells household and personal-care products. These do not overlap with restaurant meals or franchise services.
data.notes_matthew: Church & Dwight is Arm & Hammer and OxiClean. Household products, no food or restaurant business.

data.reason: Wendy's operates and franchises quick-service restaurants selling prepared food. Church & Dwight makes branded household, personal care and specialty products and sells them through retailers. The products differ, and so does the business model: restaurant and franchise royalties versus CPG manufacturing sold to retailers. Both reach individual consumers, but through different channels.
Different industry: Church & Dwight sells household, personal care and specialty products rather than restaurant meals.

P2.1.text: Consumer Packaged Goods | Church and Dwight Company Overview

P2.2.text: We are one of the fastest growing Consumer Packed Goods companies that has outpaced competition with brands like Arm & Hammer, First Response, and more.

P2.5.text: We’ve been making products that millions enjoy and rely on.

P2.6.text: Added to the S&P 500 our brands are instantly recognizable across three primary segments:

P2.7.text: Our Consumer Domestic segment includes our thirteen power brands, ARM & HAMMER™, Trojan™, First Response™, Nair™, Spinbrush™, OxiClean™, Orajel™, Vitafusion™, Batiste™, XTRA™, WaterPik™, Flawless™ and ZICAM™.

P2.8.text: Our Consumer International segment sells a variety of household and personal care products across Canada, France, Australia, the United Kingdom, Mexico, and China.

P2.9.text: Our Specialty Products segment is the largest U.S. producer of sodium bicarbonate, used in a variety of industrial, institutional, medical, food and specialty cleaning applications. Additionally, in this segment we provide a growing range of animal agriculture productivity and wellness products.

P2.10.text: We're a growing business, a close-knit team, and committed to providing products consumers can rely on today, tomorrow and for many years to come.
